name: empty
useFor: Use when a list, a search or a view has nothing to show: say what is missing and give the one next action (New card, Clear search). Name the bar like a file (cards.list, search.results) or pass name={null}. It is shadcn's Empty API in the EmptyState look; use EmptyMedia variant icon for a lucide glyph.
constraints: Empty states that blame the reader
source: Extrapolated from Agentcard: the EmptyState (agentcard-website src/app/globals.css .v7-windowbar) and the white key (.v7-btn)
title: Empty
description: An empty list as a quiet window: the sky bar, a centered key glyph, a display title, one muted line and one action on the pale ground.
